blocks.text: Generate and Test algorithm ke do bare qadam hain:

items: Generate: is qadam mein algorithm masle ke mumkin hal banata hai. Yeh hal randomly (bina soche, kisi bhi tarteeb mein), systematically (tarteeb se) ya kisi heuristic (tajurbe se bana andaze ka rule) ki base par banaye ja sakte hain.

Test: hal banane ke baad algorithm use masle ki requirements ya constraints (hadon) par jaanchta hai. Agar hal tamam conditions (shartein) poori kare to use valid (sahi) mana jata hai. Agar nahi, to algorithm naya hal banata hai aur yahi process dohrata hai.

blocks.text: Yeh program aise do whole numbers (poore number) dhoondta hai jin ka jama total aur zarb product ho: har qadam par ek jora generate karta hai (banata hai) aur phir test karta hai (jaanchta hai). total aur product ki values badal kar Run karein aur dekhein kitni koshishein lagti hain.

total = 10     # a + b must equal this
product = 21   # a x b must equal this

def generate_and_test():
    for a in range(total + 1):
        b = total - a                          # generate a possible answer
        print("Try a =", a, "b =", b, "-> a x b =", a * b)
        if a * b == product:                   # test it
            return a, b
    return None

answer = generate_and_test()
if answer:
    print("Found:", answer)
else:
    print("No pair of whole numbers works.")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"total = 10" aur "product = 21": hamein aise do numbers a aur b chahiyein jin ka jama 10 aur zarb (multiply) 21 ho.
"def generate_and_test():": function (alag kaam ka tukra) jo Generate and Test tareeqa chalata hai.
"for a in range(total + 1):": a ko 0, 1, 2 ... 10 tak ek ek kar ke leta hai.
"b = total - a": generate wala qadam: a ke saath aisa b banata hai ke a + b hamesha total ho.
"print(\"Try a =\", ...)": har koshish (try) screen par dikhata hai.
"if a * b == product: return a, b": test wala qadam: zarb sahi ho to foran wahin ruk kar jora wapas (return) kar deta hai.
"return None": tamam jore aazmane ke baad bhi na mile to None (kuch nahi) lautata hai.
"if answer: ... else: ...": jora mila to "Found:" print, warna "No pair of whole numbers works."
Output: char koshishein (a = 0, 1, 2, 3) print hoti hain; a = 3, b = 7 par 3 x 7 = 21 milta hai, is liye aakhir mein "Found: (3, 7)".
Khud try karein: product = 24 kar ke Run karein: paanchwi koshish par "Found: (4, 6)". product = 30 karein to 11 koshishon ke baad "No pair of whole numbers works." aayega.

blocks.prompt: Generate and Test algorithm ke basic qadam bataiye (short question 2).
blocks.explanation: 1) Ek mumkin hal banayein (generate). 2) Use tamam conditions par jaanchein (test). 3) Agar paas ho to usi hal par ruk jayein. 4) Warna naya hal bana kar phir jaanchein, jab tak hal na mile ya mumkin hal khatam na hon.

items: Do qadam: generate (randomly, systematically ya heuristic se) aur test (tamam constraints par); sahi hal milne tak chakkar.
